> **As of 2026-10-29.** The fleet (carbon, RedBaron, ryzen7, orch, Wintermute Hub) keeps four memory stores and two mechanisms that feed or sync them. Each store answers a different question: *what did Joe say* (Claude auto-memory), *what did a session learn* (recall), *what is true about a subsystem* (summa vault, this wiki), *what did the kernel see* (memlog). Inventory verified on carbon 10-29 3:0x PM from live units, files and CLI help; rb/r7/orch/hub inferred from the git repos, not queried live. Owner: the carbon aide for sync health; every seat writes to stores 1 and 3.
